reason: Discord leg of the provider-neutral terminal notice: when the lifecycle terminal edit carries the structured view, render it with discordJobNotificationEmbed on the edit/post of the running card instead of markdown text; rejection falls back to text. Scope: discord progress helper, discord.ts, discord-delivery.ts, message-mutations helper if edit must accept embeds, discord test.

residual_risks: D-0066: dedupe ignores the view (text and view derive from the same data, so they change together)
quality.summary: Discord terminal notice is the native embed in the same single message. Lite window Q-0090 (base 40d26aee3 -> HEAD): Discord renders the terminal progress edit with discordJobNotificationEmbed when the structured view is present (same message id, components kept); fallback only when Discord's structured errors identify embeds as the sole invalid field, fallback edit clears embeds, fallback post is a single truncated message; DiscordRestError retains code/errors/message. Proof: discord suite 111 green, unit lane 675/9022 green, integration lane green, tsc, architecture, verify.py passed (one load-flake rerun). Autoreview 5 rounds: 5 findings accepted+fixed; final theoretical dedupe point deferred D-0066 per the scope governor.
